response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and system design—directly aligned with the role's technical focus—he lacks the critical people management experience required. The position explicitly requires 2 years of people management or team leadership; his resume shows no evidence of managing reports, conducting performance reviews, or leading teams. His career has progressed exclusively along the individual contributor track (currently Staff Software Engineer), not the management track. The technical qualifications are strong but insufficient to overcome this fundamental gap for a full-time people-leadership position.
strengths: Deep expertise in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD systems (test automation frameworks, GitLab administration, MCP code generators)
Strong software craftsmanship mindset with demonstrated commitment to TDD, code quality, and best practices across multiple languages and domains
Extensive full-stack technical capability with proven hands-on system design and architectural contributions across web, mobile, and embedded systems
concerns: No demonstrated people management experience or team leadership—no evidence of managing reports, conducting 1-on-1s, or performance reviews
Career trajectory exclusively along individual contributor track with no formal management titles or organizational change leadership experience
Limited evidence of strategic roadmap planning, cross-team stakeholder alignment, or the strategic communication skills critical for mid-level management

key_factors.factor: Technical Depth and System Design Capability
